links.outcome: Frequency of verification failures among LLM incidents recorded in research and informatics workflows
links.effect: Verification failure was one of four tied most frequent categories (n=7 of 45 incidents); the claimed-verification gap was described as a measurable failure mode distinct from hallucination.
links.quote: Four categories tied as most frequent: verification failure, factual numerical error, tool-behavior misunderstanding, and citation or reference formatting (n=7 each).

unlisted_practices: Practitioner-audit framework (TRACE) with structured response scoring to document downstream workflow harm from LLM errors

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating a practitioner-audit method (TRACE) to capture and classify workflow harms and LLM errors during real clinical-informatics and clinical-adjacent workflows.
